subject: Winthrop Street Construction and Eversource Mitigation
overview: The City Council approved several utility permits and addressed ongoing infrastructure concerns, primarily focusing on resident frustration regarding the lengthy Eversource construction project on Winthrop Street. The Council also voted to request expanded senior parking and trash barrel cleaning services.

items.title: Used Auto Sales Special Permit: 78 Swan Street
items.summary: Approved a Class 2 used auto sales special permit for Eric Shakes of Chicken and Shakes Automotive.

items.title: Grant of Location: Boston Avenue Underground Conduit
items.summary: Approved a grant of location for National Grid to install 65 feet of underground electric conduit on Boston Avenue to support the Green Line Extension.

items.title: Grant of Location: Boston Avenue Sidewalk Service
items.summary: Approved a second grant of location for National Grid to install secondary electrical service under the sidewalk of Boston Avenue.

items.title: High Street Paving and Traffic Island Safety
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting full curb-to-curb paving at the High Street and Woburn Street intersection and a safety report regarding the visibility of a new traffic island.

items.title: Winthrop Street Sidewalks and Eversource Mitigation
items.summary: Approved a resolution demanding that Eversource install new sidewalks and curbing on Winthrop Street from Wildwood Road to Playstead Road to mitigate years of construction disruption.

items.title: Special Outdoor Dining Regulations
items.summary: Withdrawn after the governor extended special outdoor dining provisions, rendering the resolution unnecessary.

items.title: Residential Barrel Cleaning Service
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to procure a vendor to power wash residential trash and recycling barrels to address rodent and sanitation concerns.

items.title: Senior Center Parking Policy
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city provide adequate parking permits and time limits for residents using the senior center as part of new parking enforcement changes.

items.title: Committee Reports and Routine Business
items.summary: Approved committee reports regarding Open Meeting Law violations and budget procedures, adopted previous meeting records, and set the summer meeting schedule.
